description: Publish a site from a GitHub repository and republish it on every push. Works with private repositories. The first time, it returns a link the person opens to let Hostlo read their repositories; after they have, call it again. No builds are run: the folder is published as it is (found automatically, or given).

branch.description: The branch to follow. Leave out for the repository's default branch.

folder.description:
The folder holding the site, such as dist or public. Leave out to have it found; "/" means the
repository root, which makes every web file in the root public.

repo.description: The GitHub repository, as owner/name (for example maria/bakery) or its github.com URL.

name: connect_repo
